$comment: EVERY PUBLISHED SET IN THE KIT, and what this catalog does about it. Generated from the kit walk (.github/workflows/figma-refs.yml) joined to the @CatalogComponent references in the sources; CatalogKitCoverageTest holds the two together in both directions, so a set cannot be quietly dropped and an exclusion cannot outlive the limitation that earned it. Out of scope, and not listed: the kit's own internals (names beginning '.', and the 'Base components' each page builds its published set from) and the 1072-component Icons page, which is an icon set rather than a component inventory.

sets.excluded: Avatars are app content rather than a Wear Compose component: the kit draws the shapes an app fills, and there is no composable to invoke.

Compose puts the image container painter on Button and Card; IconButton takes no painter, so there is no round image-backed button to invoke.

ConfirmationDialogContent reveals itself over ~528ms — children fade in from a LaunchedEffect, and SuccessIcon draws its check with a 267ms trimPathEnd tween. A still capture never reaches the resting frame: the plain sticker is an empty container ring, and @ScrollingPreview(END) lands mid-tween with the check drawn as a chevron. The renderer already settles long enough after a scroll, so the gap is only a way to ask for that without one: yschimke/compose-ai-tools#4202. Back in the day a preview can ask to be captured settled.

IMPLEMENTED BUT NOT COMPARABLE — the exclusion is about the reference, not the component. `Media/PlayerScreen` (Horologist's `PlayerScreen`, see sections/MediaControls.kt) reproduces this set, but the published cell `71575:22329` does not EXPORT as the player: its `.Base / Media / Album Artwork/Primary NEW` child composites over the full 192×192, and exported on its own it stops compositing and covers everything, so the reference image is an opaque purple wash. A comparison against that reports the whole frame and means nothing, so the mapping is withdrawn rather than published. The two `AOD=Yes` cells (`71575:22344`, `71575:22375`) carry no artwork instance and export faithfully — this becomes mappable again when the exporter composites the overlay.
